name: CaseHardTextPartPinnedSize
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-text-part-pinned-size" (geometry). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a TEXT-BEARING part pinned to its ancestor box by position:absolute + width/height
